# 119. Momentum, miljardärer och marknadens minne

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-08-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN's Börssurr episode 119 mixes light Stockholm-lifestyle banter with a serious markets discussion, centered on Boliden's share-funded acquisition of Nexa Resources (bringing Brazilian owner Votorantim in as top holder), a lengthy bull/bear debate on continued market gains dominated by momentum and the AI-capex boom versus stretched valuations, rising rates and US fiscal/Trump risks. Company-level talk covers Volvo Cars' CEO-to-chairman succession, Latour, a bullish view on Tomra, Mycronic's capital markets day, and Lyten's unpaid bills after buying Northvolt. The tone is analytically cautious but acknowledges that upward momentum keeps trumping the bearish arguments.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BOL — Boliden | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Storägaren Votorantim tar bara 7% via aktieaffär; värden tror de vill äga mer vilket skapar köpläge trots att marknaden ogillar affären.

#### Reasoning

Host reasons that when a large owner is accumulating, one should buy; Votorantim's 7% stake seems too small and likely to grow, making Boliden attractive. Zinc via Nexa Resources is hot (up 77%) and it's a functioning business, a Swedish industrial expanding into South America. Counter: analysts are critical, large acquisitions often disappoint, operational issues at home, and payment is dilutive via new shares.

#### Sell Triggers

- om Votorantim inte ökar sitt innehav
- om nyemissionen/förvärvet röstas ner på extrastämman
- om integrationen av Nexa misslyckas
- om zinkpriset faller

> *"det gör mig till köpsugen i Boliden, trots att marknaden inte gillar det här"*

---

### 🟢 TOM — Tomra | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Latours vd Johan Hjärtonsson är bullish; stark Q2-raketrapport och tillväxt via nya pantsystem i Spanien, Portugal och Polen.

#### Reasoning

Cited guest/analyst view: Latour's CEO Johan Hjärtonsson says Tomra has a fantastic future across its three divisions (food, recycling, reverse vending), driven by rollout of deposit-return systems in major European countries. One of the strongest quarters ever reported. Business fundamentals strong even though the share has been a poor performer; hosts note pant-machine business is cyclical with country rollouts, and maskiner kan vara opålitliga.

#### Sell Triggers

- om utrullningen av pantsystem i nya länder försenas
- om cykeln i reverse vending vänder ner
- om Q3/Q4 inte bekräftar Q2-styrkan

> *"Tomra har en fantastisk framtid för sig"*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Håkan Samuelsson blir ordförande och Li Shufu lämnar; kan göra bolaget mer investerbart och mindre utländskt.

#### Reasoning

Host speculates that with the invisible major-owner chairman Li Shufu stepping back and Samuelsson (who shows up and communicates) taking the chair, Volvo Cars could become more investable and less foreign-controlled. Purely governance-driven, speculative, no fundamental catalyst discussed; also sits within a broadly negative European auto backdrop.

#### Sell Triggers

- om corporate governance inte faktiskt förbättras
- om Li Shufu behåller kontrollen i praktiken
- om europeisk bilindustris kris förvärras

> *"Kanske gör det att Volvo Cars blir lite mer investerbart och lite mindre utländskt"*

---

### 🟠 MYCR — Mycronic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Kapitalmarknadsdag på måndag; har nått sina mål och en möjlig måluppjustering kan komma. Bure-ägt.

#### Reasoning

Host wonders whether Mycronic, which holds a unique position making large machines for screen manufacturing and has met its targets well, could deliver a target upgrade at its upcoming capital markets day. Speculative and event-driven; hosts admit they don't fully understand the business and don't cover it often.

#### Sell Triggers

- om ingen måluppjustering presenteras på kapitalmarknadsdagen
- om efterfrågan på skärmtillverkningsmaskiner viker

> *"jag undrar om det kan komma någon slags måluppjustering på den kapitalen"*
